title: Version sort order
description: An ordered list of version-sort criteria. The server never evaluates this list; it is a viewer preference the watch payload's version list applies client-side, so the attribute set is limited to the fields that payload carries. An empty list and an absent value both mean no override: the version list keeps the ranking the selected quality profile already returns.

attribute.description: Version attribute to sort by, in descending priority order. Only the attributes the watch payload exposes are allowed; server-only ranking keys such as source, confirmed and language are not accepted here.

direction.description: desc puts larger or better values first; asc puts smaller or worse values first.
